drivingQuestion: Why does the mishna restate that one gives and receives rights?
outcomeNote: The answer comes in the next unit (eruvin.sugya271).

segments.he: שֶׁאֶחָד נוֹתֵן רְשׁוּת. הָא תּוּ לְמָה לִי? אִי נוֹתֵן — תְּנֵינָא, אִי נוֹטֵל — תְּנֵינָא?
segments.en: The mishna explains: «For one» resident «may give away» and receive «rights» in a domain. The Gemara poses a question: «Why» do «I» need «this further» explanation? This ruling can be deduced from the previous cases: «If» the mishna wishes to teach the halakha with regard to «giving» away rights, «we» already «learned» that one person may give away his rights in a domain, and «if» it wishes to teach the halakha with regard to «receiving» rights, «we» already «learned» it as well, so why the repetition?
